issue.title: Match score returns 0 for candidates with no uploads
issue.body:
The scorer short-circuits when a candidate has no uploads and we end up writing a literal 0 instead of skipping the row.

Relevant code:

- https://github.com/my-org/primary-app/blob/main/src/services/MatchScoreService.ts#L118-L146
- `src/lib/matchScore/messageBuilder.ts:88`

Related to #7.
